items.title: Modern Abstract Diagonal Fretwork CNC Lattice
items.description: Introduce sharp, contemporary geometric complexity using this high-coverage modern abstract lattice design, composed of multiple layers of precise intersecting diagonal lines. This bold fretwork vector template is provided in clean, scalable DXF, SVG, and DWG formats, making it perfect for Scandinavian and industrial-style decors. Optimized specifically for CNC milling, laser engraving, and wood routing on premium sliding doors, commercial space dividers, and feature wall cladding requiring a dynamic, textured aesthetic.
